Header.value: Step 2: Select all dark patterns present (if applicable)

Choice.hint: Repeated Interruptions - Same popup shown multiple times after dismissal
Persistent Upgrade Prompts - Constant reminders to upgrade to paid
Rating/Review Harassment - Repeated prompts to rate the app
Reminder Overload - Excessive email/notification reminders
Multi-Step Cancellation - Too many steps to cancel
Hidden Opt-Out - Opt-out buried or hard to find
Confirmshaming - Guilt-trip language on decline button
Forced Navigation Detours - Redirected to irrelevant pages
Preselected Defaults - Options pre-checked by default
Slow-Down Tactics - Artificial delays or timers
Data Walls - Blocked until personal info provided
Complex Navigation - Intentionally confusing layout
Hidden Fees - Fees revealed late in checkout
Drip Pricing - Price revealed piece by piece
Disguised Ads - Ads that look like content
Disguised Buttons - Deceptive button styling
Auto-Add to Cart - Items added without consent
Ghost Charges - Undisclosed auto-billing
Sneaky Email Subscriptions - Pre-checked newsletter
Masked Choices - Hidden consequences of actions
Visual Noise - Too many competing elements
Misleading Contrast - Accept bright, decline dim
Hidden Buttons - Close/decline hard to see
Moving Buttons - Buttons that shift position
Bait Contrast - Wrong action highlighted
Confusing Hierarchy - Unclear what to click
Layout Sabotage - Important options buried
Obstruction UI - Popups blocking alternatives

Collapse.title: Forced Action (FA) - Blocking until action taken

Choice.hint: Forced Registration - Must create account to proceed
Forced Data Sharing - Must provide unnecessary data
Impossible-to-Decline - No way to say no
Forced Continuation - Can't skip upsells/tours
Forced Subscription Start - Must start trial
Gated Access - Core features locked
Mandatory Add-ons - Can't buy without extras
Fake Reviews - Fabricated or cherry-picked reviews
Fake Activity Counters - '50 people viewing this!'
Fake Scarcity from Social - 'Someone just bought this'
Manipulated Testimonials - Scripted success stories
Social Pressure UI - 'Join 200,000 users!'
Fake Countdown Timer - Timer that resets
Exaggerated Deadline - 'Offer ends today!' (every day)
Fake Limited-Time Bonuses - Always-available 'bonuses'
Fabricated Time Pressure - Vague urgency language
Fake Low Stock - 'Only 2 left!' (not true)
Fake Limited Availability - Digital products with 'limited seats'
Artificial Constraints - Options hidden to push premium
Fake Waitlists - Instant approval after 'waitlist'
